_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
A recording started right after typing consumes that text's saved copy. The test seeded the conversation at /c/composer-recorded and another conversation {{VIEWED}} at /c/{{VIEWED_SLUG}}. The page fakes the microphone, screen capture and MediaRecorder, and window.__recordingMock counts what the page asked for (read it with eval, e.g. "window.__recordingMock.recorderStarts"): displayRequests (screen captures requested), synchronousDisplayRequests (those requested inside a click or keydown handler), microphoneRequests, audioSources, recorderStarts, recorderStops and stoppedTracks (media tracks stopped). "The recording state" is the data-state attribute of ".recording-status". To "select conversation X from the drawer": if the button with aria-label "Open conversations" is visible, click it; then wait for ".conversation-item[data-conversation-id=\"X\"]" to be visible, click it, and wait until it has the class "active". The recorder "floats" while the recording panel is inside a [data-testid="recording-floating"] element: count '[data-testid="recording-floating"] [data-testid="recording-panel"]' (1 when floating, 0 when not). Call "saved text" returns the text the server keeps for /c/composer-recorded's composer, or "(none)". Message submissions are accepted without being sent on; call "chats" counts them, and call "send" tells which saved text the last one said it was composed from. The message input is [data-testid="message-input"], the voice button [data-testid="voice-button"], the recording panel [data-testid="recording-panel"], and its stop, cancel and retry buttons [data-testid="recording-stop-button"], [data-testid="recording-cancel-button"] and [data-testid="recording-retry-button"]. When a step says an element should contain or have some text, assert that on that element, not with a page-wide wait_text. Perform the steps in order. 
1. Navigate to /c/composer-recorded and wait (up to 30s) for the message input to be visible.
2. Fill the message input with "context typed just before 7a1b", then at once click the voice button.
3. Exactly one [data-testid="recording-inline"] should exist, and window.__recordingMock.recorderStarts should become 1.
4. Select conversation {{VIEWED}} from the drawer. The URL should have exactly the path "/c/{{VIEWED_SLUG}}" (an exact "value", not "text").
5. The recorder should float.
6. Call "saved text"; it should become "context typed just before 7a1b" (up to 10s).
7. Click the stop button. Call "chats" should become "1".
8. Call "send"; it returns "the saved text".
